correctness.rationale: Universal proof covers n>=4 and every 0<=p<q<n. Explicit b a^h b a^j witnesses attain all four formula cases. A rank-monotone potential proves the matching lower bound by checking all a,b transitions on rank >=n-2 and excluding lower-rank detours. Every pair is counted exactly once in the histogram. Standalone checker confirms 451 independent pairwise BFS distances, 451 witness executions, 220 histogram entries, 23014 potential transitions, with no computation substituted for proof.
